entities.name: Ibn Al-Thahabi

entities.summary: Abu Mohammed Abdellah Ibn Mohammed Al-Azdi, known also as Ibn Al-Thahabi or Ibn al-Zahabi was an Arab physician, famous for writing the first known alphabetical encyclopedia of medicine.
